summary_md: **Waldrada ([@Waldrada](https://x.com/Waldrada/status/2116091693434855432))** updates the **Polaris Anniversary Fork** of llama.cpp for old RX480/RX580 cards, adding Vulkan sparse-attention ops for GPUs without fp16, a GPU 'hot spare' cache of the most-used MoE experts while the rest stays in system RAM, and a learned next-expert predictor with its training pipeline ([Lanilen/llama.cpp](https://github.com/Lanilen/llama.cpp)).
